description: iBody.pl is Poland's largest database of fitness venues — 8,100+ gyms, yoga and pilates studios, dance and martial-arts schools in 100+ cities, with weekly class schedules and prices collected and refreshed automatically. Ask for any activity in any Polish city — yoga in Warsaw, reformer pilates in Krakow, crossfit in Gdansk — and get matching clubs with addresses, prices and accepted sports cards (Multisport, Medicover and more). Then pull up any club's weekly class schedule and full price list. Every result links to the club's public profile on ibody.pl, where you can see exact dates, instructors and book a class online.
